predictionSource: executed online prefix baseline association, not Oracle segmentation

labelReview.note: Labels frozen before new predictions. AI evaluation, not independent human blind ground truth. Open kitchen/living functional split is an explicit product granularity convention; doorway buffers deliberately generous. No metric coordinates or room IDs used to assign labels. Full intermediate crossing review remains pending.

granularity: existing reviewed local core regions; subregion labels not yet available

stability.note: Node renaming is invariant. Repairs are not harmful instability. Persistence is not correctness; all-unknown has no stability score and stable wrong grouping still fails correctness.

finalCorrectness.note: Balanced score equally weights same/different relations and counts unknown as unrecovered. Conditional accuracy must accompany coverage. Boundary/ambiguous truth excluded; evaluate region and subregion layers separately.

correctness.note: Balanced score equally weights same/different relations and counts unknown as unrecovered. Conditional accuracy must accompany coverage. Boundary/ambiguous truth excluded; evaluate region and subregion layers separately.

contentRecognition.note: Success requires at least one relevant historical observation and no irrelevant returns. Partial content recall separate. Explicit historical inventory forbids self/future retrieval; it must be built from the executed prefix, not final memory.

contentQueryDefinition: Each reviewed core observation with earlier same-core observations is a query. Retrieve earlier reviewed observations sharing its actual prefix node. This tests group membership retrieval, not object semantics. Correlated adjacent frames, not independent revisit events.
limitations: Single AI-reviewed nonblind recording. Boundary observations excluded. No invented val5 full labels or physical/subregion truth; existing legacy mini benchmark remains separate.
